svg.title: Figure 3-1 · ODD taxonomy
svg.desc: Tree of the reference ODD of WP-C-02 §3.1: Road type, Geometry, Lane markings, Speed, Weather, Lighting, Road surface, Traffic, VRUs, Geography, Infrastructure, Connectivity, Vehicle state, Driver state. Each attribute shows the value included in ODD-H; the ODD is limited-access highways only. The horizontal curve radius bound is proposed (GAP-04, OI-2), grade and banking bounds are to be confirmed (OI-5), and the ambient temperature bound is TBD (OI-3).
svg.text: Reference ODD of §3.1 by category and attribute, with the value included in ODD-H (highways only). The whole ODD is proposed.
Limited-access divided highway (Interstate, freeway, expressway) incl. merge/weave lanes
R ≥ v²/2.5 m/s² at the travel speed (table §3.2)
Crests with stopping sight distance per design standards
Visible longitudinal markings on at least one side, US MUTCD style
0 – 110 km/h (68 mph), not above the posted limit
At or above the highway speed floor, proposed 60 km/h (37 mph); the value is set in the FSR (DQ-280 A)
Following a lead to standstill and auto-resume, once engaged above the floor
None or light rain: below 2.5 mm/h (US NWS class; DQ-413 A)
Within the device operating range (to be specified from device data, OI-3)
Day; dusk/dawn; night with headlights (with or without street lighting)
Paved asphalt or concrete; dry or wet
Mixed traffic incl. trucks; lead vehicles; cut-ins from adjacent lanes
Not handled reliably; driver must act
Continental US, right-hand traffic, US MUTCD signs and markings
Maintained, unmodified, no active DTCs, VSC on, device mounted and calibrated
Licensed, briefed, attentive, face visible to the driver camera, hands near the wheel
bound proposed or to be confirmed (open item named)
value says the system does not handle it reliably; the driver must act
Drawn with the table’s own categories; the excluded conditions and the basis of each row are in §3.1. Status tags: §3.2, §3.1 Basis and the open items of §7.
